3. By the instant Criminal Revision, the revisionist has prayed to set aside order of the Special Judge, (POCSO Act)/Additional Sessions Judge, Farrukhabad dated 16.10.2023 in Special Sessions Trial No. 76 of 2021; State of U.P. vs. Ajay Pal under Section 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act,

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the revisionist has stated that no cross-examination has been taken up qua the victim and the fundamental right of the applicant stands violated.
He has also stated that the applicant has every right to defend himself.
Although, he has fairly conceded the fact that the previous counsel did not cross-examine the witness despite several opportunities.
He prays that present counsel has been subsequently engaged by the revisionist and he states that he shall not seek any adjournment to cross-examine the victim.

5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has opposed the instant Criminal Revision on the ground that changing of counsel is not a ground to allow the application under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
6.

After hearing both the parties and taking into consideration the valuable right of the revisionist,
one last opportunity is granted to him to cross examine the witness.
No adjournment shall be granted to him except under exemplary circumstances and he shall pay the arrears of the cost fixed by the Court concerned.
7. As such, the Criminal Revision is allowed and as a last opportunity, the applicant is permitted to cross-examine the witness P.W. 1, which shall be taken up on day to day basis.
